English: Spindle Stand
A basic, makeshift stand for spinning wool and flax, allowing the first steps of textile production among Iranian nomads.
Threaders Tent
A communal tent where spinners and threaders gather, increasing the speed and scale of textile preparation in the camp.
Loom Hut
A sturdy hut housing basic looms, enabling expanded weaving and the creation of simple textiles for the horde.
Dye Pavilion
A pavilion equipped for dyeing cloth, introducing vibrant colors to nomadic textiles and attracting skilled dyers to the horde.
Patterned Room
A specialized structure where intricate Iranian weaving patterns are taught and crafted, greatly improving textile quality and production.
Carpet Hall
A grand hall devoted to the weaving of ornate carpets, producing goods prized from the steppes to the Persian heartland and encouraging artisan migration.
Fine Textile Chamber
A secure chamber for crafting and storing rare textiles and silks, providing the horde with prestige goods and trade leverage.
Guild Pavilion
An impressive pavilion where master craftsmen lead organized workshops, standardizing textile production and training apprentices.
Master Weavers Room
A private chamber reserved for the greatest weavers, whose expertise allows the horde to produce legendary textiles for trade and prestige.
Iranian Textile Guild
A permanent guild uniting all textile masters and craftsmen, turning the horde into a center of textile innovation, trade, and prosperity.
